title: Audio levels
description: The file game/tuning/audio.json: the music's and the effects' levels and the number of effect channels, read in both run modes. DRA-158. The file must exist and every field is required: nothing has a default in code. The levels are the GDD's audio_levels (12-art-and-audio.md, guess); a sound's loudness is its master times its own level, both in percent. effect_channels is the Architect's pick (scope report DRA-158, Values needed), not in the GDD. Loaded and checked by game/app/audio_tuning.py at startup into AudioLevels. Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/audio.md.

music_master.description: The music's master level, percent. Loudness of the loop is this times loop_level. An int or a float, never a bool. Maps to AudioLevels.music_master. GDD: audio_levels (music master).

effects_master.description: The effects' master level, percent. Loudness of an effect is this times its own level. An int or a float, never a bool. Maps to AudioLevels.effects_master. GDD: audio_levels (effects master).

loop_level.description: The music loop's own level, percent. An int or a float, never a bool. Maps to AudioLevels.loop_level. GDD: audio_levels (loop).

hit_level.description: The hit effect's own level, percent. Never above 100: a louder hit is a louder file. An int or a float, never a bool. Maps to AudioLevels.hit_level. GDD: audio_levels (hit).

graze_level.description: The graze effect's own level, percent. An int or a float, never a bool. Maps to AudioLevels.graze_level. GDD: audio_levels (graze).

coin_level.description: The coin effect's own level, percent. An int or a float, never a bool. Maps to AudioLevels.coin_level. GDD: audio_levels (coin).

game_over_level.description: The game-over effect's own level, percent. Never above 100: a louder sound is a louder file. An int or a float, never a bool. Maps to AudioLevels.game_over_level.

level_up_level.description: The level-up effect's own level, percent. An int or a float, never a bool. Maps to AudioLevels.level_up_level.

effect_channels.description: How many effects can sound at once. A cue that finds no free channel is dropped; a playing sound is never cut. Maps to AudioLevels.effect_channels. Not in the GDD: the Architect's pick (scope report DRA-158, Values needed).
